config.floating_training_precision: BF16 autocast forward/backward, FP32 stored parameters and FP32 evaluation
config.quantization: all29 Conv/Linear W[-7,7] A[-7,7], STE learned scales, FP32 accumulation
config.frozen_batchnorm: running statistics frozen from floating checkpoint throughout QAT and hardware finetuning; affine parameters trainable
config.hardware_assumption: same independent synthetic held-error model as DeiT, not physical calibration
config.mapping: 128 rows x128 columns, 2-bit cells, four signed activation bits, W+7 offset digits with exact digital correction
config.ordering: independent reads parallel on CUDA; serial returned-code and held-value feedback within each read; reset across array/bit/token/reduction tile
config.selection: best validation accuracy then lowest CE; include epoch0; tests only after selection frozen
config.dataset_history: Same CIFAR-100 dataset has been evaluated previously in project; not a fresh blind benchmark. No external full-CIFAR-trained weights.

cause_protocol.purpose: Bounded matched 2x2 training experiment for prior zero-gating opportunity decrease
cause_protocol.initialization: all from same original W4A4; no checkpoint continuation
cause_protocol.data: same2000 hardware train/500 hardware validation; validation-only mechanism study, no new test selection
cause_protocol.controls: same seed, augmentation sequence, AdamW/cosine LR1e-5..1e-6, BN running stats frozen, teacher and CE+KD loss

cause_protocol.factor_definitions: voltage factor changes P-node and held reference; prefix factor changes returned-code restriction; interactions not assumed additive
cause_protocol.metrics: per-layer element zeros, block-bitplane zeros, encoded digit zero columns, learned scales, gate and conversion counts; cross-evaluate each weight set under all4 inference conditions
cause_protocol.physical_limits: same B985ps signed-P table and edge extrapolation; no new physical-interface claim
